value.name: Brown Street Coffee Run
value.description:
Our Week 6 Spring Quarter coffee run is here, and this time, DUCC is heading back to Green Line Cafe! Taking place on Saturday, May 9 & Sunday, May 10 ☕️

How It Works:
Members signed up for the event will meet at Mario the Dragon Statue and head to Green Line Cafe's West Philly location (2545 Brown St, Philadelphia, PA 19130) together. Both runs will start at 11 AM. If you can’t make the group meet-up, feel free to meet us directly at the café! Please note we will be walking or taking SEPTA to and from the coffee shop, so please dress appropriately!

Event Sign-Up:
Spots are first come, first serve, with a limit of 10 members per day to ensure we don’t overwhelm the café. If you’ve signed up but can no longer attend, please let us know the night before.

On Monday, May 6, an email will be sent out with a Google Form link for sign-ups and a reminder of the event details. Be sure to check your inbox!

If you can’t make this event, there will be many more coffee runs are coming for the upcoming 2026-2027 academic year!

 

Important: If there are any questions, feel free to reach out to us via email at drexelcoffeeclub@gmail.com or on our Instagram @drexelcoffeeclub.

value.name: Getting Started in Medical Student Research: Library Resources & Research Basics
value.description:
These two sessions, led by Sarah Hughes, Health Sciences Librarian with Drexel University Libraries, will introduce medical students to library resources and foundational research skills. Topics will include getting started with research, developing a research question, understanding different types of projects such as literature reviews, scoping reviews, and systematic reviews, choosing appropriate databases, building a search strategy, and using concepts such as MeSH terms, PICO, and PRISMA.

The sessions will also include time for questions and discussion. This event is especially intended for students interested in beginning or strengthening research projects over the summer, but all DUCOM students are welcome to attend.

value.name: Honors Program Info Session
value.description:
Drexel's Honors Program, offered by the Pennoni Honors College, actively encourages students to think deeper and explore their curiosity.

 

The Honors Program is open to all majors and allows students to gain access to small, discussion-based classes, exclusive cultural events in Philadelphia, Honors-specific advising and mentoring, and unique civic engagement opportunities.

 

The Honors Program application will be live on April 1 to first- and second-year students. The deadline to apply is June 2.

 

Interested in learning more about the Honors Program and its offerings? Attend this information session, hosted by Honors Program Advisor Kenyon Walter-Privott.

 

RSVP HERE

 

If you have questions about the Honors Program or the application, please email honorsprogram@drexel.edu.

value.name: Picnic in the Park!
value.description: Get ready to enjoy the perfect spring day with Drexel CAB at our Campus Picnic at Drexel Park! Come relax, unwind, and soak up the sunshine with friends at this fun, food-filled outdoor event. Long picnic tables will be overflowing with delicious options—from fresh sandwiches and crispy chips to cookies, sweet treats, refreshing juices, and sodas, there’s something to satisfy every craving. Grab a picnic basket and blanket, gather your friends, and set up your perfect spot on the grass while you enjoy the beautiful park setting. Play games and get active after having a bite to eat! Feeling creative? We’ll also have a flower bouquet station where you can craft your own colorful arrangements to take home or share with a friend. Whether you’re here to munch, mingle, or just soak in the sun, this picnic is the ultimate way to spend a spring afternoon on campus. Bring your friends, your appetite, and your picnic vibes—fun, food, and flowers await! 🌸🧺🥪

value.name: Wednesday Community Group
value.description:
Crosswalk Fellowship is your home away from home! We’re a Christian college fellowship within Metro Church, with students living in the Philadelphia area between the ages of 18-22. We gather as a community representing various schools to learn, encourage, challenge, and mature as Christians.

We meet for Community Groups on Wednesdays/Thursdays on Campus. The specific building & room varies, so text “Crosswalk” to 94000 to connect with us, so we can help you get plugged in! We also meet for Sunday Worship at Metro Church (East Falls), 9:30AM/11:30AM. Rides are provided to both services! Text “Crosswalk” to 94000 for more information on rides.

If you have any questions, you can email andrew@metrophilly.org. Follow our Instagram @CrosswalkFellowship to stay in the loop!
